## Outcome

What should an operator or API caller be able to do? For a defect, include the
steps to reproduce it and the observed behavior.

## Acceptance checks

How will we verify the result? Name the relevant rig, device, browser or REPL
workflow where that affects verification.

## Coordination and evidence

Record the owner and affected paths when work starts. Link dependencies,
related pull requests, the tested revision and results here. Close the issue
when the acceptance checks pass.
